title: Relational Database Tables & Data Types
description: Understand database tables, primary key IDs, field data types (Short Text, Number, Date/Time), and records.
objectives: Understand the difference between Excel spreadsheets and relational Access databases
Define field names and select correct Data Types

steps.title: Introduction to Databases
steps.content: Microsoft Access stores structured records in relational tables. Fields represent columns (e.g. FirstName, Price), and Records represent rows.

quiz.question: What is the role of a 'Primary Key' in a database table?
options: It uniquely identifies each individual record in a table without duplicates
quiz.explanation: Primary keys enforce unique identification for every record (row) in a database table.

title: Primary Keys & Table Relationships
description: Connect database tables using One-to-Many relationships and Foreign Key links.
objectives: Enforce Referential Integrity to prevent orphaned records
Link Customer IDs to Order records

steps.title: Relational Integrity
steps.content: Relational databases avoid data redundancy by splitting information into related tables (e.g. Customers table linked to Orders table via CustomerID).

quiz.question: What does 'Enforce Referential Integrity' prevent in Access table relationships?
options: It prevents creating orders for non-existent customers (orphaned records)
It prevents opening Access without a password
It limits the database to 10 rows
quiz.explanation: Referential Integrity ensures child records (Orders) must point to valid parent records (Customers).

title: Visual Query Builder & Data Filtering
description: Build Select Queries to filter, search, sort, and calculate data fields visually without code.
objectives: Build Select Queries using the Query Design grid
Apply criteria filters (e.g., >500 AND City='Phnom Penh')

steps.title: Querying Database Records
steps.content: Queries answer specific questions by filtering and combining fields across multiple related tables into dynamic view grids.

quiz.question: Which query type retrieves and displays specific filtered data rows from one or more tables?
quiz.explanation: Select Queries retrieve and present filtered record subsets based on defined criteria.

title: Data Entry Forms & Custom Input Masks
description: Design user-friendly data entry forms, add navigation buttons, and enforce phone/date input masks.
objectives: Generate clean Data Entry Forms from tables using Form Wizard
Add command buttons (Save, Delete, Next Record)
Configure Input Masks for phone numbers and zip codes

steps.title: User-Friendly Data Entry
steps.content: Forms provide an intuitive graphical interface for end users to enter, view, and update database records safely.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of an 'Input Mask' on a Form field?
options: It restricts input syntax structure (e.g. forcing (###) ###-#### phone number formatting)
It hides the form from public view
It exports the form to Excel
It changes the form background image
quiz.explanation: Input Masks guide end users to enter data matching exact visual formatting patterns.

title: Automated Reports & External Data Import Pro
description: Generate printable business reports with headers/footers and import/export data from Excel spreadsheets.
objectives: Calculate page subtotals and grand totals
Import Excel datasets and export Query results to CSV

steps.title: Reporting & Data Exchange
steps.content: Reports format database records into clean, printable PDFs or hardcopy documents complete with logos and page totals.

quiz.question: Which Access object is specifically optimized for formatting and printing summary data?
quiz.explanation: Reports format query or table data specifically for printing or PDF publishing.

title: SQL Queries & Database Maintenance Pro
description: Write raw SQL statements (SELECT, WHERE, JOIN), execute Action Queries (UPDATE, DELETE), and compact databases.
objectives: Inspect and write SQL SELECT statements
Execute UPDATE and DELETE action queries safely
Use Compact and Repair Database utility

steps.title: Database Optimization & SQL
steps.content: SQL (Structured Query Language) is the universal underlying database query language. Compact & Repair reduces file bloat and fixes database errors.

quiz.question: Why should you regularly run the 'Compact and Repair' tool in Microsoft Access?
options: It defragments the database file, recovers wasted space, and fixes index errors
quiz.explanation: Compact and Repair shrinks file size and fixes database corruption errors.
